Buffelsdrift Game Lodge
Oudtshoorn, Klein Karoo.
Buffelsdrift Game Lodge
Creating Memories
It s the simple idea of ​​offering all our guests the breakaway they deserve.
Buffelsdrift Game Lodge, your gateway to the untamed beauty of the Klein Karoo.
Nestled just 6.5 kilometers outside of Oudtshoorn, the Ostrich capital of the world, Buffelsdrift Game Lodge offers a unique and understated elegance in luxury tented-accommodation, making it the perfect escape for those seeking a true African experience. With the majestic Swartberg Mountains as a backdrop and a waterhole at your doorstep, you ll be immersed in the untamed beauty of South Africa. The lodge features a range of luxurious tented accommodations, including Waterhole tents with private decks for wildlife viewing and Family tents for group getaways.
Buffelsdrift Game Lodge provides a tranquil atmosphere, complete with a private swimming pool for relaxation under the Karoo sun.
But the real magic lies in its wildlife experiences. From thrilling Bush Safaris to Night Drives and Meerkat Safaris, you can get up close to Africa s incredible creatures. Observe elephants, witness the power of lions, and marvel at free-roaming cheetahs. For those seeking a romantic setting, a charming wedding chapel overlooking a natural waterhole awaits. Conveniently located just a 5-hour drive from Cape Town and an hour from George Airport, Buffelsdrift Game Lodge is the perfect destination for adventure, relaxation, or a romantic escape in the heart of the Klein Karoo.

Accommodation
Luxury Waterhole Tents
Experience contemporary "bushveld" comfort in one of our Luxury Waterhole tents. These tents are perfect for those who enjoy "living on the edge", as they each feature a private sundeck, right at the edge of our main waterhole, ideal for you to soak up the sun, relax and enjoy the splendor that unfolds. Enjoy sundowners on the deck whilst viewing our free-roaming animals in the water and surrounding banks.
Luxury Family Tents
Each of the Luxury Family tents have a spacious main bedroom and a second bedroom with an interleading, shared en-suite bathroom. These units can accommodate a family of up to 5 people. The family tents provide an elevated view of the surroundings and Swartberg Mountains and is within walking distance of the 5 hectare waterhole. True Karoo fynbos and bushveld surround these tents, creating an authentic bushveld experience. You may even be able to see wildlife around your tent, so keep your eyes peeled.
Luxury Horizon View
These luxury tents are set only a few meters away from the waterhole and provide an elevated view of the surroundings. They also have great views over the whole lodge area and are surrounded by true Karoo fynbos.

Seizing every moment
We want to make sure that every single moment during your stay will be enjoyable and memorable. Explore all the opportunities we offer you to discover at Buffelsdrift Game Lodge.
Authentic Karoo Cuisine
Specializing in authentic Karoo cuisine, the Buffelsdrift Restaurant offers guests a delicious a la carte menu of homemade foods and local fresh produce. As accompaniment, our wine selection consists of some of the best award-winning wines on Route 62, South Africa’s longest wine route.

Buffelsdrift Foundation and Volunteering
We believe that everyone can contribute to conservation and therefore our vision is to empower ordinary people to protect nature.  The key to conservation is not to do conservation, but to live conservation actively. By creating this kind of lifestyle, we fulfill our purpose of helping humans and nature to live together in harmony.

Buffelsdrift Foundation and Volunteering
We believe that everyone can contribute to conservation and therefore our vision is to empower ordinary people to protect nature.  The key to conservation is not to do conservation, but to live conservation actively. By creating this kind of lifestyle, we fulfill our purpose of helping humans and nature to live together in harmony.
If you are looking to make a difference by actively participating in the conservation of African wildlife within a fun, safe, stable and stunning environment, Buffelsdrift Game Lodge is the place for you.

The perfect location
Buffelsdrift Game Lodge is situated in the heart of the Klein Karoo which is part of the world famous Garden Route, Western Cape in South Africa. We are located 6.5 km just outside of Oudtshoorn, the Ostrich capital of the world. The lodge is situated only 300 meters from the tar road leading to the Cango Caves.
Activities
01.
Free-roaming Cheetah Experience
In April 2020, we introduced our South African cheetahs to our guests. After two years of being on the Reserve and being a part of our family, our cheetahs are now adapted and have relaxed in their new environment. We are aiming to create a platform to educate tourists about this predator in its natural environment.
